title: mystic_forge
summary: A pipeline that fetches real Magic: The Gathering card data from mtgjson.com, engineers structured features, and generates synthetic trading cards mimicking the original distribution. It trains SDV's CopulaGANSynthesizer (with Metadata schema) on card subsets and samples new synthetic rows from the fitted models.
